Alex Jefferson (7:15 A.M.)
Hi, Sophie. I'm on the bus and just realized
I left my office key at home. Could you
meet me outside to let me in?

Unfortunately, I'm not in the office this
morning.
Alex Jefferson (7:17 A.M.)
Oh. Can you think of anyone else? I'm
going to be there in a few minutes.

You could try Winston.
Alex Jefferson (7:19 A.M.)
Good idea! Do you have his number?
Sophie Browning (7:20 A.M.)
Sure, hold on just a minute.
